<header class="dg-head dg-head-section"><p class="dg-kicker">Chapter 7 <span class="dg-sep">•</span> <a href="index.html">Metric</a></p><h1 class="dg-title"><span class="dg-secnum">7.4</span> Curvature of the Metric</h1></header>
<ul class="dg-itemize dg-depth-1">
<li><p>From now on, <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{Riem}\)</span> and <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{Ric}\)</span> denote the curvatures of <span class="math inline">\(\nabla^{\text{LC}}\)</span>, both determined by <span class="math inline">\(g\)</span> through <span class="math inline">\(g \longrightarrow \nabla^{\text{LC}} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Riem} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Ric}\)</span>. Using <span class="math inline">\(g\)</span> once more, through <span class="math inline">\(\flat\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(\flat^{-1}\)</span> or <span class="math inline">\(g\)</span> itself, we define:</p>
<ol class="dg-enumerate dg-depth-1">
<li><p>The <strong>Riemann–Christoffel curvature</strong>, the <span class="math inline">\((0,4)\)</span>-tensor field  <span class="math display">\[
                    \mathrm{Riem}^\flat(\mathcal{W}, \mathcal{Z}, \mathcal{X}, \mathcal{Y}) \coloneqq \mathrm{Riem}\big( \flat(\mathcal{W}), \mathcal{Z}, \mathcal{X}, \mathcal{Y} \big),
                    \qquad
                    (\mathrm{Riem}^\flat)_{ajkm} = g_{al} \, \mathrm{Riem}^l_{jkm} ,
                \]</span>  the components following from <span class="math inline">\(\flat(\partial x_a) = g_{al} \, dx^l\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p>The <strong>Ricci scalar</strong>, the scalar field (chart independent, as <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{Ric}\)</span>)  <span class="math display">\[
                    R \coloneqq \mathrm{Ric}\big( \flat^{-1}(dx^m), \partial x_m \big) = (g^{-1})^{mk} \, \mathrm{Ric}_{km} \in C^\infty(\mathcal{M}),
                \]</span>  using <span class="math inline">\(\flat^{-1}(dx^m) = (g^{-1})^{mk} \, \partial x_k\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p>The <strong>Einstein curvature</strong>, the <span class="math inline">\((0,2)\)</span>-tensor field  <span class="math display">\[
                    G \coloneqq \mathrm{Ric} - \frac{1}{2} \, R \, g ,
                    \qquad
                    G_{ab} = \mathrm{Ric}_{ab} - \frac{1}{2} \, R \, g_{ab} .
                \]</span></p></li>
</ol></li>
</ul>
